summary: Drawable-batch processor: spin-waits for render-position synchronization (calling a progress callback per iteration), then for each enabled 84-byte sprite descriptor allocates a row buffer from a sub-allocator and dispatches per-row render calls through a per-slot vtable entry. Finally advances the total position counter and returns a completion code (3 = more positions remain, 4 = batch finished).

operations.description: v3 = *(this+0x118) - 1: line position limit reduced by one, saved in v11 for later reuse.
v20 = *(this+0x184) (frame info pointer); a dword array at frameInfo+0x48 is walked, one element per sprite slot, and each element is passed as an allocation index.

Spin-wait until position sync completes: current sub-position (this+0x7C) is at or past sub-position limit (this+0x84) AND (when equal) scan position (this+0x80) exceeds total position limit (this+0x88).
Each spin iteration invokes the progress callback at vtable entry 0 of this+0x18C with (this); a falsy return aborts the whole function early.
Object processing runs only while the sprite-object count (this+0x20) is greater than zero.
Walk the descriptor array at this+0xC4, one 84-byte descriptor per slot, for slotIndex 0..(count-1) where count is this+0x20.
Per descriptor: the byte flag at descriptor+0x30 must be non-zero for the slot to be processed and drawn.

Allocate a row buffer through the sub-allocator vtable this+0x4, entry 0x20: allocate(this, index = *(frameInfo+0x48 + slot), width(descriptor+0xC) * total position limit(this+0x88), width(descriptor+0xC), 0); the returned pointer is stored in v13.

Per-slot row count v21: when total position limit (this+0x88) is >= (line position limit (this+0x118) - 1), v21 = descriptor+0x20 % descriptor+0xC, forced to descriptor+0xC when the remainder is zero; otherwise v21 = descriptor+0xC (full width).
Render dispatch function v12 = dword at *(this+0x198) + 4*slotIndex + 4; the per-slot word v16 is loaded from a2[slotIndex].

Row loop over v21 passes: each pass iterates stride(descriptor+0x1C) rows, calling v12(this, descriptor, base + 128*row, v16, rowCounter), advancing the row source offset by 128 and the row counter by descriptor+0x24; stride is re-read from descriptor+0x1C each iteration.
After each row pass, v16 advances by 4 * descriptor+0x24, and v3 is restored from its saved value.
At the end the total position counter at this+0x88 is incremented to mark the position as consumed.
Return 4 - (++*(this+0x88) < *(this+0x118)): 3 when more positions remain below the line position limit, 4 when the batch is complete.

unresolved: Meaning of the per-slot word loaded from a2[slot] and its role as the v16 render argument is unconfirmed.
Descriptor+0x30 is read in the raw source as a byte enable flag, but the existing analysis labels it 'Y stride in buffer'; the two readings conflict and are not reconciled.
Return codes 3 (more positions remain) vs 4 (batch finished) are an interpretation of the 4 - (counter < limit) expression, not independently proven.
The 'v3 = v11' restore after the row loop appears to be a decompiler artifact since v3 is not modified in between.
